mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and increasing its plasma concentration, while chlorpromazine may inhibit omeprazole metabolism via CYP2C19.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostatic hypotension); consider dose adjustment or alternative proton pump inhibitor if toxicity occurs.
